skill.name: applying-brand-guidelines
skill.description: Applies corporate brand colors, fonts, layouts, watermarks, and validation checks to document configuration workflows.
skill.summary: Applies and validates corporate brand standards for documents.
skill.author: anthropics

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when documents drift from brand standards. This skill applies and checks colors, fonts, layouts, tone, and formatting rules.
actual_capabilities: Applies brand styling to Excel workbook configurations.
Applies slide master, title slide, content slide, and chart settings to PowerPoint configurations.
Applies PDF page, header, footer, text, and table style settings.
Validates colors, fonts, tone keywords, prohibited words, and brand name capitalization.
Generates chart palettes, watermark settings, formatted numbers, and validation suggestions.
limitations: The included brand is Acme Corporation and should be customized for production use.
The scripts return configuration data and do not directly edit binary document files.
Color correction uses a simplified closest color fallback.
Validation checks text patterns and cannot judge every visual design issue.

use_cases.title: Standardize Executive Presentations
use_cases.description: Create PowerPoint configuration settings that match approved colors, title bars, slide templates, charts, and footer rules.

use_cases.title: Check Marketing Copy
use_cases.description: Review text for brand name capitalization, prohibited wording, tone alignment, approved colors, and approved fonts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Reports
use_cases.description: Apply PDF headers, footers, watermarks, margins, typography, table styles, dates, and classification labels.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Branding
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand guidelines to my document configuration for a PDF report. Include page layout, header, footer, text styles, and table styling.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Existing Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for brand compliance. Check colors, fonts, tone, prohibited words, and brand name capitalization. Return violations and suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Build Presentation Standards
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a branded PowerPoint configuration for an executive review. Include title slide, content slide, chart colors, footer settings, and bullet rules.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Brand Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the Acme brand rules for my organization. Replace colors, fonts, tone keywords, prohibited words, tagline, logo rules, and validation guidance.

output_examples.input: A PDF report needs brand styling for headers, footers, margins, headings, body text, and tables.
output: PDF layout uses letter pages with one inch margins.
Header includes logo, document title, and page numbering.
Footer includes copyright, date, and confidential classification.
Headings, body text, captions, and tables use approved fonts and colors.

output_examples.input: Marketing copy includes an unapproved red color, Comic Sans, and lowercase brand name.
output: Validation fails because the color is not in the approved palette.
Validation flags Comic Sans as an unapproved font.
Validation suggests correcting the brand name capitalization.
The report includes a compliance score and practical fixes.

output_examples.input: A quarterly dashboard needs Excel formatting and chart color standards.
output: Headers use white text on the approved primary blue.
Data cells use the approved navy text color.
Rows use light gray alternation for readability.
Charts use the approved palette for each data series.

best_practices: Replace the sample Acme values with your approved brand assets before use.
Validate final content after applying formatting so text and visuals stay aligned.
Keep brand colors, fonts, tone keywords, and prohibited words in a reviewed source file.
anti_patterns: Do not use the sample brand values as production policy without review.
Do not assume the scripts directly modify PowerPoint, Excel, or PDF files.
Do not ignore validation warnings when preparing external communications.

faq.question: What document types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides configuration support for Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF documents.

faq.question: Can I use my own brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the Acme sample colors, fonts, tone keywords, prohibited words, and logo rules.

faq.question: Does it edit files directly?
faq.answer: No. The helper scripts return structured configuration and validation results for other tooling to apply.

faq.question: What does the validator check?
faq.answer: It checks colors, fonts, prohibited words, tone keywords, and brand name capitalization.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Is this ready for regulated brand programs?
faq.answer: It is a useful starting point, but regulated programs should add legal, accessibility, and approval workflow checks.
